regionalSelectionNote: Up to 24 strongest observed directed links per 15-minute departure bin whose origin and destination cell centroids are at least 10 km apart. Distances use the great-circle formula with mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km. Trip counts are unchanged; this is a display subset, not the full network.
aggregateRegionalSelectionNote: Up to 24 strongest observed directed cell pairs after summing all trip records across November 1–5, 2021, selected from the full source bundle. Origin and destination centroids must be at least 10 km apart. Order is descending aggregate count, then origin and destination node indices. This stable network is independent of the dynamics playback time. Counts are observed trip records; animated particles illustrate movement along schematic connections, not tracked individual people or observed travel paths.
allAggregateSelectionNote: Every positive directed cell pair after summing all recorded trips across November 1–5, 2021, from the complete source bundle. No distance threshold or link-count limit is applied. Order is descending trip count, then origin and destination node indices. Same-cell records and records with an endpoint outside the 1,117 observed cells remain excluded, as in the source bundle. Arcs connect cell centroids and do not represent continuous observed travel paths.
definition: Observed direct-trip record counts. Each raw trajectory with both endpoints inside the displayed metropolitan grid contributes one directed origin-to-destination trip to the 15-minute bin containing its departure time. Same-cell trips are excluded. Counts are trajectory records, not distinct devices, model predictions, or inferred transitions between state snapshots.
stateComparisonNote: The flow map shows trips departing during the displayed 15-minute bin. Trip duration, entry and exit from the study area, and differences between trip records and snapshot counts mean these arrows are not asserted to sum exactly to the change in the observed population series.
